correct_completion: I will order a big meal.
full_sentence: I am very hungry, so I will order a big meal.
acceptable_variants: I want to eat a lot.
I will get a large dinner.

options.text: I will pay the bill now.
options.why_wrong: Paying the bill usually happens at the end of a meal, so it is not a result of being hungry.
'Yesterday' is past time, but 'so' needs a result that follows from the present feeling of hunger.

options.text: I will order a big meal.

options.why_wrong: This is a new fact, but it is not a result of being hungry, so it does not complete the 'so' clause.

explanation: The connector 'so' introduces a result. The second part must be a logical consequence of the first part, here the feeling of being very hungry. Ukrainian speakers may use a similar structure, but they sometimes mix up 'so' with 'because', which gives the reason instead of the result.
translation: Я дуже голодний, тому замовлю велику порцію.
